mapper.select: /* SQL ID : QstnVwitmDAO.qstnVwitmList 설 명 : 문항보기항목목록조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM WHERE QSTN_ID = #{qstnId} ORDER BY QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO

/* SQL ID : QstnVwitmDAO.qstnVwitmBulkList 설 명 : 문항보기항목일괄목록조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM WHERE QSTN_ID IN (SELECT QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_QSTN WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND (EXAM_DTL_ID = #{examDtlId} OR EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{exrcsSddnQstnBscId})) ORDER BY QSTN_ID, QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : QstnVwitmDAO.qstnVwitmAllDelete 설 명 : 문항보기항목전체삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM WHERE QSTN_ID IN ( SELECT QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_QSTN QSTN WHERE (QSTN.EXAM_DTL_ID = #{examDtlId} OR EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{exrcsSddnQstnBscId}) )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : QstnVwitmDAO.stdntExampprQstnVwitmList 설 명 : 학생시험지문항보기항목목록조회 */ SELECT VWITM.QSTN_VWITM_ID , VWITM.QSTN_ID , VWITM.QSTN_VWITM_CTS , VWITM.CRANS_YN , EXAMPPR.LVL AS QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO FROM ( SELECT EXAMPPR.* , REGEXP_SUBSTR(EXAMPPR.QSTN_VWITM_DSPLY_SEQ, '[^@#]+', 1, LEVEL) AS VWITM_DSPLY_SEQNO , LEVEL AS LVL FROM ( SELECT * FROM TB_LMS_EXAMPPR WHERE TKEXAM_ID = #{tkexamId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} ) EXAMPPR CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(EXAMPPR.QSTN_VWITM_DSPLY_SEQ, '@#') + 1 AND PRIOR EXAMPPR.QSTN_DSPLY_SEQNO = EXAMPPR.QSTN_DSPLY_SEQNO AND PRIOR DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE IS NOT NULL ) EXAMPPR JOIN TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM VWITM ON EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID = VWITM.QSTN_ID AND EXAMPPR.VWITM_DSPLY_SEQNO = VWITM.QSTN_VWITM_SEQNO ORDER BY EXAMPPR.QSTN_DSPLY_SEQNO, EXAMPPR.LVL
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : QstnVwitmDAO.qstnVwitmListAllDelete 설 명 : 문항보기항목목록전체삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_QSTN_VWITM WHERE QSTN_ID IN ( SELECT QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_QSTN WHERE EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{id} OR EXAM_DTL_ID IN ( SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{id} ) )
